decisions.question: Test decision
options: A
B
C

decisions.question: How should we slice the issue into shippable units?
options: Option A: One feature set — all four tools + both skills + submit_task fix in a single plan→implement cycle (matches issue framing; large scope)
Option B: Sequenced — tools land first, then skills; rebuild_and_rollout deferred per issue (Recommended)
Option C: Skills-first, shelling out to kubectl/existing tools, adding MCP tools only where kubectl won't work
Option D: Minimal subset — only prune_stale_worktrees and validate_deployment_manifests plus submit_task doc fix; everything else becomes follow-ups

decisions.question: What should back validate_deployment_manifests?
options: External kubeconform binary for schema + Python for semantic checks (mixed)
kubectl apply --dry-run=server for structure + Python for semantic checks (requires cluster access)
Pure Python on parsed kustomize output — no external deps, most portable, more code to maintain (Recommended)
Delegate structural to kubectl --dry-run=client, do all semantic checks in Python

decisions.question: How should validate_network_isolation run its probes?
options: Spawn a throwaway probe Job in egg-agents and read its logs — isolated, costs a Job lifecycle per call (Recommended)
pods/exec into an existing agent pod if one is present, else spawn a Job — cheaper when pipelines are live, wider RBAC
Always use pods/exec into a long-lived probe Deployment we add to the overlay — persistent overhead, fastest per call

decisions.question: What should happen when submit_task is called with a pipeline_id whose previous run was just cancelled with cleanup=true?
options: Add fresh=true flag on submit_task; without it, keep current 409 behavior; with it, wait for in-flight cleanup then create (Recommended)
Make cancel_task(cleanup=true) block until cleanup finishes (synchronous); no submit_task change
Document only — cancel_task(cleanup=true) + immediate submit_task is documented as non-idempotent; caller waits
Have submit_task detect cancelled+cleanup-in-progress state and queue the new run behind it

decisions.question: Short-lived agent pods (<10s lifespan) lose their logs before kubectl logs can fetch them. The issue flags this as a separate concern. Where should it land?
options: Separate follow-up issue; agent-diagnose ships with documented best-effort log fetch (Recommended)
Pull it into #1759's scope — needed for agent-diagnose to be reliable
Fold it into #1760 (the reconciliation false-positive is the main producer of short-lived pods)

decisions.question: What should the default be for prune_stale_worktrees?
options: dry_run=true by default; caller must pass dry_run=false to actually remove (Recommended, matches issue text)
dry_run=false by default with a preview section in the response; matches cancel_task(cleanup=true) ergonomics
Two separate tools — list_stale_worktrees (read-only) and prune_stale_worktrees (write)

decisions.question: get_deployment_context exposes the image tag currently running per component. Until #1763 lands (SHA-tagged images), the tag is :latest which is ambiguous. What should the tool do?
options: Ship now; return :latest with a warning message; stop warning once SHA tags land (Recommended)
Block this tool on #1763
Ship now and also surface the image digest (imageID) which is unique even for :latest

decisions.question: Open-ended questions for this refine phase. Please answer each inline: (1) Any additional validation checks for validate_deployment_manifests beyond the six the issue lists? (2) RBAC posture for the orchestrator ServiceAccount — events.list obvious; pods/exec gated separately or not? (3) For validate_network_isolation, is any-claim-failure a tool failure, or should it return structured per-claim results? (4) Preferred ranking heuristic for deployment-diagnose's evidence chain? (5) Should get_deployment_context degrade cleanly across runtimes (Docker vs. Kubernetes) or hard-fail and direct callers elsewhere? (6) Naming preferences — unprefixed (validate_network_isolation) vs. prefixed (k8s_probe_isolation)?
